source_text: Et sint in signa et in tempora et in dies et in annos. Luminaria non solum lucent, sed signa dant: tempora virtutum, dies scientiae, anni profectus. Studeamus, ut in firmamento nostri cordis luminaria Verbi habeamus, ne in tenebris ambulemus, sed sicut filii lucis. Haec Homiliae I prima series a principio creationis usque ad luminaria in signa.
pass_a_gloss: And let-them-be for signs and for times and for days and for years. Lights not only shine, but signs give: times of-virtues, days of-knowledge, years of-progress. Let-us-strive, that in firmament of-our heart lights of-Word we-may-have, lest in darknesses we-may-walk, but as children of-light. These of-Homily I first series from beginning of-creation as-far-as to lights for signs.
pass_b_english: [[And let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and for years >> Bible:Genesis 1:14]]. The lights not only shine; they give signs: seasons of the virtues, days of knowledge, years of progress. Let us strive to have the Word’s lights in the firmament of our heart, that we may not walk in darkness but as [[children of light >> Bible:1 Thessalonians 5:5]]. This is Homily I’s first series, from the beginning of creation as far as the lights set for signs.
